method.name: Training historical context plus one-field model sensitivity
method.rationale: Directly query the unchanged fitted estimator; no surrogate, attribution fit or additional randomness.
method.fit_scope: Reuse evaluate: grouped seed-42 partition; preprocessing and forest fit only on training rows.
method.local: For each field, replace only that field by each observed nonmissing training category; keep all other normalized proposal values fixed.
method.delta: hypothetical model estimate minus original proposal model estimate; not additive contributions, causal effects, or feasible changes
method.historical: Training-only raw effort summaries and nominal Hamming nearest examples; equal weight per predictor, missing equals missing; ties by original row index.
method.global: Training-only Step 5 categorical eta squared; univariate marginal association, never a local prediction contribution.

global_historical_associations.scope: Training rows only; global marginal associations, not causal effects or local additive contributions.

method.name: Univariate categorical eta squared on raw observed Effort-
method.formula: eta2 = sum_g n_g * (mean_g - mean_all)^2 / sum_i (effort_i - mean_all)^2
method.interpretation: Fraction of within-sample raw effort variation between observed categories, ranging from 0 to 1; strength has no sign.
method.eligible_rows: For each factor: observed nonnegative finite effort and nonmissing normalized category only.
method.undefined: null score and no rank for fewer than two observed categories or zero total effort variance.
method.ordering: Descending eta2 rounded to 12 decimal places; equal rounded scores share competition rank, then factor name alphabetical. Undefined factors are separate.
method.direction: Category mean minus the feature-specific eligible mean; higher/lower/equal uses relative tolerance 1e-12 and absolute tolerance 1e-12. Medians and quartiles are also reported.
method.inference: Exploratory only; no significance tests, multiplicity claims or certified wins.
method.fitting: No fitted model or learned preprocessing; no train/evaluation split is required for descriptive summaries.

Small historical observational dataset; one grouped split is not a guarantee of future accuracy.
No uncertainty intervals, approval guarantees, causal claims, or held-out tuning.
No proposal-time size estimate is supplied; delivered Kloc+ is excluded.
Predictor availability at proposal time is assumed and must be checked operationally.
Unseen categories encode as all zeros; missing categories use an explicit empty-string level.
Rows missing Effort- are excluded, never target-imputed; reported MAE is row-weighted.
Group split prevents identical normalized inputs crossing partitions, but related projects may remain.
Random forest predictions average training outcomes and may miss extreme or novel efforts.
Evaluation model remains fitted only to training rows; no full-dataset refit is performed.

Delivered size, defects, identifiers and other metadata are excluded. Proposal-time availability of supplied predictors must be verified.
Training-based global associations can be confounded by project size and correlated characteristics; small categories and extreme efforts can dominate.
